name: space-keeper
description: A Mac + Windows dual-platform disk space steward for everyday users: scans temp files and app caches, produces a visual space analysis report (HTML, printable to PDF, plain-language and professional versions), then cleans only what the user confirms — never over-deletes app caches that would break daily use.

displayDescription.en: Dual-platform (macOS + Windows) space steward: scan temp files and app caches, generate a visual space analysis report, clean only what you confirm — never over-delete.
displayDescription.zh: 双平台磁盘空间管家：扫描临时文件与应用缓存，出可视化空间报告，确认后清理，绝不误删

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 扫一下临时文件和应用缓存，出一份空间占用报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: Scan my temp files and app caches, show me how much space they take, generate an analysis report, and clean up only what I confirm

tags.zh: Mac 与 Windows 双平台

quickPrompts.en: Scan my temp files and app caches, give me a report showing where space goes
quickPrompts.zh: 扫一下临时文件和应用缓存，出一份空间占用报告

quickPrompts.en: Clean the junk you listed — only what I confirmed, keep my apps working
quickPrompts.zh: 按我刚才勾选的清单清理，别多删，别影响应用正常使用

quickPrompts.en: Show me how to clean up a specific folder by myself
quickPrompts.zh: 告诉我怎么自己清理某个文件夹
